review:
Sevens and fruit on 10 fixed paylines, built around four jackpots. Crown Scatters drive it: the more you land, the higher you climb on the Mini, Minor, Major and Grand ladder.

The 5,000x Grand can be won two ways: five Crown Scatters, or a full screen of 15 Sevens. Chance Level multiplies the bet by up to 10x to improve jackpot odds. Medium-high volatility, 96.15% RTP. Simple retro reels with a real jackpot to aim for.
